daily_summary.es: GitHub Copilot añade GPT-6 Astra para tareas agénticas, Asahi Linux llega a los Mac M3 y Anthropic detalla cómo contiene a sus agentes Claude frente a un riesgo cada vez mayor.
daily_summary.en: GitHub Copilot adds GPT-6 Astra for agentic tasks, Asahi Linux reaches M3 Macs, and Anthropic details how it contains its Claude agents against growing risk.

apple.es: Asahi Linux ya soporta oficialmente los Mac con M3, M3 Pro y M3 Max (aunque no M3 Ultra, y con GPU y sueño aún pendientes), mientras Apple prepararía un servicio de seguridad para el hogar en 2027 y Meta lanza una app nativa de Meta AI para Mac de solo 16MB.
apple.en: Asahi Linux now officially supports M3, M3 Pro and M3 Max Macs (though not M3 Ultra, with GPU and sleep support still pending), while Apple reportedly plans a home security service for 2027 and Meta ships a native Meta AI Mac app weighing just 16MB.

ai_software.es: GPT-6 Astra de OpenAI ya está disponible en GitHub Copilot para tareas de codificación autónomas y de largo plazo, y Anthropic explicó públicamente cómo contiene el radio de impacto de sus agentes Claude Code y Cowork mediante defensas superpuestas en el modelo, el entorno y el contenido externo.
ai_software.en: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra is now available in GitHub Copilot for long-horizon, autonomous coding tasks, and Anthropic publicly explained how it contains the blast radius of its Claude Code and Cowork agents through overlapping defenses across the model, environment, and external content.

ai_general.es: Un análisis sobre infraestructura de IA sostiene que el movimiento de datos, no solo el cómputo, se ha convertido en el nuevo cuello de botella y en una decisión estratégica de negocio, mientras un ensayo de Jakub Pachocki reflexiona sobre el reto de mantener alineados a sistemas de IA cada vez más capaces.
ai_general.en: An analysis of AI infrastructure argues that data movement, not just compute, has become the new bottleneck and a strategic business decision, while an essay by Jakub Pachocki reflects on the challenge of keeping increasingly capable AI systems aligned.

tech.es: The Seattle Times y Newsday demandaron a OpenAI y Microsoft por infracción de derechos de autor, señalando que Copilot se basa en la tecnología de OpenAI, mientras Anthropic anunció Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, que combina retención cero de datos con detección automatizada de mal uso sin revisión humana de la empresa.
tech.en: The Seattle Times and Newsday sued OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement, noting that Copilot is built on OpenAI's technology, while Anthropic announced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, combining zero data retention with automated misuse detection that requires no human review by the company.

title.es: GPT-6 Astra de OpenAI llega a GitHub Copilot
title.en: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra arrives in GitHub Copilot

body.es: GPT-6 Astra, el modelo de propósito general más reciente de OpenAI, ya está disponible en GitHub Copilot. Está diseñado específicamente para tareas de codificación autónomas y agénticas de largo horizonte, lo que sugiere un salto hacia flujos de trabajo menos supervisados dentro del editor. Los desarrolladores que usan Copilot podrán delegar tareas más complejas y prolongadas al agente sin intervención constante.
body.en: GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI's latest general-purpose model, is now available in GitHub Copilot. It's specifically designed for long-horizon, autonomous coding and agentic tasks, signaling a push toward less-supervised workflows inside the editor. Copilot developers can now delegate more complex, extended tasks to the agent without constant intervention.

evidence.claim: GPT-6 Astra is now available in GitHub Copilot.
GPT-6 Astra is designed for long-horizon, autonomous coding and agentic tasks.

title.es: Asahi Linux añade soporte oficial para Mac con chip M3
title.en: Asahi Linux adds official support for M3 Macs

body.es: El proyecto Asahi Linux ahora soporta oficialmente Macs con M3, M3 Pro o M3 Max, y los desarrolladores afirman que casi todo lo que funcionaba en M1 y M2 'simplemente funciona' en M3. Sin embargo, el M3 Ultra queda fuera por ahora, y el soporte de DCP, la GPU y el sueño del sistema aún tienen limitaciones importantes. El equipo ya trabaja en soporte para M4 y M5.
body.en: The Asahi Linux project now officially supports Macs with M3, M3 Pro or M3 Max chips, with developers claiming almost everything that worked on M1 and M2 'just works' on M3. However, M3 Ultra is left out for now, and DCP support, the GPU, and system sleep still have significant limitations. The team is already working on M4 and M5 support.

evidence.claim: Asahi Linux now supports Macs with M3, M3 Pro, or M3 Max chips.
M3 Ultra is not yet supported by the operating system.
Almost everything supported in the M1 and M2 releases now 'just works' on M3.
DCP support and the GPU are major exceptions to M3 support.
Development is ongoing to support M4 and M5 chips.

title.es: Seattle Times y Newsday demandan a OpenAI y Microsoft
title.en: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft

body.es: The Seattle Times y Newsday presentaron una demanda por infracción contra OpenAI, nombrando también a Microsoft como demandado porque su Copilot se basa en la tecnología de OpenAI. Ni OpenAI ni Microsoft respondieron de inmediato a la solicitud de comentarios. Se suma a la creciente lista de editoriales que cuestionan legalmente el uso de contenido periodístico para entrenar modelos de IA.
body.en: The Seattle Times and Newsday filed an infringement lawsuit against OpenAI, also naming Microsoft as a defendant since its Copilot is built on OpenAI's technology. Neither OpenAI nor Microsoft immediately responded to a request for comment. This adds to the growing list of publishers legally challenging the use of journalistic content to train AI models.

evidence.claim: Microsoft is named as a defendant in the lawsuit because Copilot is built on OpenAI’s technology.
OpenAI and Microsoft did not immediately respond to the lawsuit.

body.es: Anthropic anunció Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), que combina retención cero de datos con detección automatizada de mal uso, sin revisión humana por parte de Anthropic. Los clientes podrán almacenar los datos de monitoreo en su propia infraestructura en la nube (como S3, Azure Blob o Google Cloud Storage), bajo sus propias claves y políticas de acceso. El despliegue comenzará por fases este otoño en Claude Code, Claude Enterprise, Bedrock, Google Agent Platform y Microsoft Foundry, entre otros.
body.en: Anthropic announced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), combining zero data retention with automated misuse detection that requires no human review by Anthropic. Customers will be able to store monitoring data on their own cloud infrastructure (such as S3, Azure Blob, or Google Cloud Storage), under their own encryption keys and access policies. Rollout begins in phases this fall across Claude Code, Claude Enterprise, Bedrock, Google's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry, among others.

evidence.claim: Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) combines zero data retention (ZDR) with state-of-the-art safeguards for detecting misuse.
EFS will be rolling out to customers in phases, starting later this fall.
EFS will be supported on Claude Code, Claude Enterprise, the Claude Platform, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry.
EFS allows customers to control how data gets reviewed and to have their data live in infrastructure they control.
EFS has automated safety monitoring, no Anthropic human review required.

title.es: Cómo Anthropic contiene a los agentes Claude
title.en: How Anthropic contains its Claude agents

body.es: Anthropic detalló su enfoque para limitar el 'radio de impacto' de agentes como Claude Code y Cowork, que tienen acceso al sistema de archivos, shell y red del usuario. La estrategia se apoya en tres capas de defensa superpuestas: el modelo, el entorno de ejecución y el contenido externo accesible. El modo automático de Claude Code, por ejemplo, reduce la fatiga de aprobaciones automatizando las que considera más seguras, aunque el riesgo teórico crece a medida que aumentan las capacidades y el acceso del agente.
body.en: Anthropic detailed its approach to limiting the 'blast radius' of agents like Claude Code and Cowork, which have access to a user's filesystem, shell, and network. The strategy relies on three overlapping layers of defense: the model, the runtime environment, and accessible external content. Claude Code's auto mode, for instance, reduces approval fatigue by automating safer approvals, though the theoretical risk grows as the agent's capabilities and access expand.

evidence.claim: The risk of deploying agents has two components: the likelihood of failure and the potential damage.
Claude Code’s auto mode reduces approval fatigue by automating safer approvals.
Defenses should overlap and complement each other to protect against various types of risks.
Claude Code runs on a user's machine and has access to their filesystem, shell, and network.
The containment of agents involves three main components: the environment in which the agent runs, the model the agent consults, and the external content the agent can reach.

title.es: Meta lanza una app nativa de Meta AI para Mac
title.en: Meta launches a native Meta AI app for Mac

body.es: Meta lanzó una app de escritorio nativa para Mac de Meta AI, en versión 1.0 beta, que pesa solo 16MB instalada y corre de forma nativa en Apple Silicon con macOS 15 o posterior. Usa AppKit y SwiftUI con WebKit para el contenido de chat, e incluye funciones específicas de Mac como adjuntar otra ventana a una conversación, ofreciendo una experiencia más robusta que la app móvil.
body.en: Meta launched a native Mac desktop app for Meta AI, version 1.0 beta, weighing just 16MB installed and running natively on Apple Silicon with macOS 15 or later. It uses AppKit and SwiftUI with WebKit for chat content, and includes Mac-specific features like attaching another window to a conversation, offering a more robust experience than the mobile app.

evidence.claim: The new Meta AI desktop app is version 1.0 beta at launch and weighs just 16MB once installed.
It runs natively on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 15 or later.
Meta AI can also attach another Mac window to a conversation.
The app includes Mac-specific hooks, making the desktop experience more robust than the Meta AI mobile app.
Meta, institutionally, seems more keen on native Mac apps than they are native Windows apps.

title.es: Gurman analiza la salida de Schiller y los planes de Ternus para la App Store
title.en: Gurman analyzes Schiller's departure and Ternus's App Store plans

body.es: Según un análisis de Mark Gurman, Phil Schiller se está alejando de su rol en Apple, en momentos en que la compañía atraviesa un cambio de liderazgo. Las señales iniciales indican que Tim Cook seguirá teniendo un peso importante en Apple pese a la transición, y se anticipa que el nuevo CEO deberá reorganizar pronto el equipo directivo de la empresa.
body.en: According to an analysis by Mark Gurman, Phil Schiller is stepping away from his role at Apple amid a leadership transition at the company. Early signs suggest Tim Cook will still loom large at Apple despite the change, and the new CEO is expected to soon need to overhaul the company's management team.

evidence.claim: Tim Cook will still loom large at Apple under the new CEO.
Phil Schiller is stepping away from his role at Apple.
The new CEO will need to overhaul the company’s management team soon.

title.es: Una mente alienígena: Pachocki sobre la alineación de la IA
title.en: An Alien Mind: Pachocki on AI alignment

text.es: En un ensayo, Jakub Pachocki reflexiona sobre los sistemas de IA cada vez más capaces y el reto de mantenerlos alineados con los objetivos humanos.
text.en: In an essay, Jakub Pachocki reflects on increasingly capable AI systems and the challenge of keeping them aligned with human goals.

evidence.claim: Jakub Pachocki reflects on increasingly capable AI and the challenge of keeping it aligned.

title.es: Apple prepararía un servicio de seguridad para el hogar en 2027
title.en: Apple reportedly planning home security service for 2027

text.es: Según un reporte, Apple tiene en desarrollo un servicio de seguridad y monitoreo del hogar previsto para 2027.
text.en: According to a report, Apple has a home security and monitoring service in the works planned for 2027.

evidence.claim: Apple is planning to launch a home security and monitoring service in 2027.

title.es: Swift avanza hacia la web con Elementary y WebAssembly
title.en: Swift pushes toward the web with Elementary and WebAssembly

text.es: Un resumen de Simon Leeb, creador de elementary-swift, repasa el progreso de Swift en la web: Elementary renderiza HTML en el servidor con una API declarativa compatible con Vapor y Hummingbird, mientras ElementaryUI corre en el navegador generando binarios WebAssembly pequeños, apoyándose en años de trabajo de la comunidad swift-wasm y Embedded Swift.
text.en: A roundup from Simon Leeb, creator of elementary-swift, covers Swift's progress on the web: Elementary renders HTML server-side with a declarative API compatible with Vapor and Hummingbird, while ElementaryUI runs in the browser producing tiny WebAssembly binaries, building on years of swift-wasm and Embedded Swift community work.

evidence.claim: Simon Leeb created the elementary-swift project to build web UIs in Swift.
Elementary is a modern and efficient HTML rendering library with a familiar declarative API.
The swift-wasm project made compiling Swift to WebAssembly increasingly viable.
ElementaryUI runs in the browser itself, producing tiny WebAssembly binaries.

title.es: HydraFusion iguala a Opus 5 con menor costo en Copilot
title.en: HydraFusion matches Opus 5 at lower cost in Copilot

text.es: HydraFusion, ahora disponible como vista previa de investigación en GitHub Copilot, iguala o supera al modelo base Opus 5 en flujos de codificación selectiva según evaluaciones controladas fuera de línea, reduciendo además el costo estimado del flujo de trabajo.
text.en: HydraFusion, now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot, matches or exceeds the Opus 5 baseline in selective coding workflows according to controlled offline evaluations, while also reducing estimated workflow cost.

evidence.claim: HydraFusion’s selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the evaluated Opus 5 baseline.
HydraFusion reduced estimated workflow cost.
HydraFusion is now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot.

developer_signals.author: mattpocockuk
developer_signals.original_text:
What techniques do you use for making AI-authored PR's easier to review?

- I.e. use /show-me by @dexhorthy for easy-to-read diffs
- Describe the changes in pseudocode
- Mermaid diagrams
- Evidence of TDD

The wildest version of this I've heard is @dctanner's agent, who uses Playwright to record a video of the frontend feature working with text-to-speech over the top. So the agent literally talks you through its change.

text.es: Un desarrollador comparte técnicas para facilitar la revisión de PRs generados por IA: usar herramientas como /show-me para diffs legibles, describir cambios en pseudocódigo, diagramas Mermaid y evidencia de TDD; el caso más extremo es un agente que graba video de la funcionalidad con narración por texto a voz.
text.en: A developer shares techniques for making AI-authored PRs easier to review: using tools like /show-me for readable diffs, describing changes in pseudocode, Mermaid diagrams, and evidence of TDD; the most extreme case is an agent that records video of the feature working with text-to-speech narration.
